questions.text: The game's fictional world draws heavily from Belle Époque France, with its visual design influenced by paintings, Art Nouveau, and French architecture.
Development of this game began in 2019.
It's made by a small French indie game studio, and this game was the studio's debut title.
The game combines turn-based combat with real-time mechanics such as parrying, dodging, and counterattacking.
It won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2025.
